messages.author: ec32e5a92a275a89
messages.subject: Mid term reports soon!
parts:
Mentors and students -- please note that the GSoC mid-term reports will be due July 15.
Yes, they come fast. Please start thinking about this and ensure that you have
communicated well what has been done and whether it meets expectations.

We unfortunately appear to already have one "Fail" (that is Google's term) in that one
student has not communicated with his mentor for a while. Thus unfortunately seems to
happen every year. However, we need to respect the aims of the program to produce useful
code. GSoC is not "free money". For those who take the program seriously, there are
generally non-money benefits available, since students become "known" to different
software communities and make contacts that can be helpful in finding study or job positions.

Do let Claudia and I know of any difficulties. Our ability to help may be limited, but we
can try to assist and advise.

Best, JN
